boards.school_name: The University of Texas at Austin
boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct UT Austin library study environments, from quiet reading rooms to collaborative spaces with documented equipment and access details.

cards.entity_name: The Hall of Noble Words Reading Room
cards.title: Hall of Noble Words Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Life Science Library, Main Building, second floor
cards.notes: Set up at a large or small table in this quiet reading room, then use its Wi-Fi for a focused individual work session.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, all-access Life Science Library reading room with substantial seating.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries describes the Hall of Noble Words as a large, all-access quiet-study room with large and small tables, Wi-Fi, and 204 seats.
cards.source_title: The Hall of Noble Words Reading Room | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Public access; non-reservable. Located in room 2.227 on the second floor of the Life Science Library.

cards.entity_name: Richard T. and Jan J. Roberts Reading Room
cards.title: Roberts Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Life Science Library, Main Building, second floor
cards.notes: Choose a table by the natural light in the Hall of Texas and keep the session quiet; the room is designated for quiet study.
cards.short_summary: A large, quiet reading room in the Hall of Texas with tables and natural light.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries identifies this as an all-access quiet-study space with natural light, large and small tables, Wi-Fi, and abundant seating.
cards.source_title: Richard T. and Jan J. Roberts Reading Room | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Public access; non-reservable. Located in room 2.228 on the second floor of the Life Science Library.

cards.title: Fine Arts Stacks Seating
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Library, fifth floor, room 200
cards.notes: Use one of the open tables among the stacks for individual work, especially if natural light and a quiet setting suit your task.
cards.short_summary: Quiet individual-study tables on the fifth floor of the Fine Arts Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries lists open seating and study tables in the Fine Arts Library stacks for quiet individual study, with natural light and capacity for 160.
cards.source_title: Fine Arts Stacks Seating | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Public access; quiet; non-reservable. Fifth floor, room 200 of the Fine Arts Library.

cards.title: PCL Quiet Stacks Seating
cards.subtitle: Perry-Castañeda Library, floors 3, 4, and 6
cards.notes: Head to a quiet stacks floor for solo reading or writing, using the available outlets and whiteboards as needed.
cards.short_summary: Non-reservable quiet-study seating distributed across three PCL floors.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries designates PCL stacks seating on floors 3, 4, and 6 for quiet individual study and lists whiteboards and outlets.
cards.source_title: PCL Quiet Stacks Seating | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Public access; quiet; non-reservable. Available on PCL floors 3, 4, and 6.

cards.title: Silent Study Area
cards.subtitle: Scholars Lab, PCL second floor, room 2.400
cards.notes: Use this quiet Scholars Lab area when you need a contemplative solo-work setting, and bring a charger for its available outlets.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, non-reservable Scholars Lab area for serious individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries says the Silent Area in the Scholars Lab was designed so serious scholars can find a contemplative, productive spot; it is quiet and has outlets.
cards.source_title: Silent Study Area | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Available to UT students; quiet; non-reservable. Located in PCL room 2.400 within the Scholars Lab.

cards.title: Scholars Lab Open Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Perry-Castañeda Library, second floor, room 2.200
cards.notes: Bring a partner or project materials to these open tables, where external displays, whiteboards, and outlets support collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: Open Scholars Lab seating with practical tools for conversation-friendly study.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries states that Scholars Lab open study spaces are accessible without reservation and provide whiteboards, external displays, and outlets.
cards.source_title: Scholars Lab Open Study Spaces | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Public access; conversation-friendly; non-reservable. Located in PCL room 2.200 within the Scholars Lab.

cards.title: PCL Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Perry-Castañeda Library, floors 3–6
cards.notes: Reserve a room with two or more UT students for a project session using movable furniture, a whiteboard, and power outlets.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group rooms for small collaborative sessions in PCL.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries lists PCL Group Study Rooms as reservable for groups of 2–12, with movable furniture, whiteboards, and power outlets.
cards.source_title: PCL Group Study Rooms | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: UT students only; groups of two or more; reservable on PCL floors 3–6. Check the reservation page for current availability.

cards.title: Graduate Landing Spot
cards.subtitle: Scholars Commons, PCL second floor, room 2.430
cards.notes: Graduate students can use the lounge and kitchenette, or reserve a media-equipped room for a study meeting with fellow graduate students.
cards.short_summary: UT graduate-student space with a lounge, kitchenette, and meeting rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries describes the Graduate Landing Spot as UT-ID-accessible space for graduate students with lounge areas, a kitchenette, and media-equipped reservable meeting rooms.
cards.source_title: Graduate Landing Spot | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: UT graduate students only; UT ID access. Non-reservable lounge space; associated Scholars Commons study rooms are reservable.

cards.title: Learning Lab 2
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons, PCL second floor, room 2.340
cards.notes: Check whether class is in session, then use this technology-rich room for group work with Airmedia, whiteboards, outlets, and movable furniture.
cards.short_summary: A 36-seat Learning Commons room that becomes study space outside class use.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries states that Learning Lab 2 has 36 seats and six flat-screen TVs with Airmedia, and that PCL Learning Labs are study space when not used as classrooms.
cards.source_title: Learning Lab 2 | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: UT students; conversation-friendly; non-reservable. Available as study space only when it is not in classroom use.

cards.title: University Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons, PCL second floor, room 2.330A
cards.notes: Use the room as open study space outside its normal service hours, or schedule a consultation when you want writing-focused support.
cards.short_summary: A Learning Commons writing-support space that also opens for study outside normal hours.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries says the University Writing Center serves university students with consultations and that its space is open study space outside normal hours.
cards.source_title: University Writing Center | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: UT students; conversation-friendly; non-reservable. Open for study outside the Writing Center’s normal hours.
